facts.text: Andrew adopted a dog named Scout, which was chosen for its fit with the dog's adventurous spirit.

evidence.quote: It took us a while to decide, but we ended up going with 'Scout' for our pup - it seemed perfect for their adventurous spirit.
That's a great name for your pup! Fits their adventurous spirit.

facts.text: Andrew plans to take Scout, Toby, and Buddy to a nearby park for their first adventure.

evidence.quote: We're gonna take Scout, Toby, and Buddy to a nearby park. It's not big, but we can all have fun and get some fresh air!

facts.text: Audrey expressed satisfaction with the grooming results of her dogs, noting their shiny coats and calm behavior in new places.

evidence.quote: Here's a pic of them, looking all groomed. Look at those shiny coats! To top it off, they were really good at the salon - I always worry about them in new places.
Wow, they look great! Love seeing them happy and calm in new places.

facts.text: Andrew has not yet taken his dogs to the groomer, but plans to do so soon.

evidence.quote: No, we haven't got the chance to take them to the groomer yet. But will do that soon!
